svg.title: 21 Multi-Agent Coordinator — Capability Routing, Waves, Escalation
svg.desc: One Node process, no network and no filesystem, that pattern-matches a request into skill-tagged sub-tasks, groups them into priority waves, routes each task to the least-loaded capability card that declares the skill, and calls that card's handler directly. The message bus records five envelope kinds for audit and carries no work. Every element cites a source line in FACTS.md.
